criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import divide` succeeds and `divide` is callable.
[R2] `divide` accepts two positional arguments in (dividend, divisor) order: `divide(10, 2) == 5` and `divide(2, 10) == 0.2`.
[R3] `divide(7, 2) == 3.5` evaluates to True (true division, not floor division).
[R9] A test function under `tests/` calls `divide` with a non-zero divisor and asserts the returned quotient.
[R10] A test function under `tests/` asserts a non-integer quotient from `divide` (e.g. `divide(7, 2) == 3.5`).
[R11] A test function under `tests/` asserts that `divide(<x>, 0)` raises `ZeroDivisionError` (e.g. via `pytest.raises(ZeroDivisionError)`).
[R12] `uv run pytest -q` exits with status 0 and reports no failures or errors.
[R13] `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
[R14] `divide`'s signature annotates both parameters and the return type (`inspect.signature(divide)` shows a non-empty annotation for `a`, `b`, and the return).
[R15] The `dependencies` list in `pyproject.toml` is unchanged (still empty).
